mapper.select: select DISTINCT c.link_id linkId,a.tenant_id, a.alarm_type as alarmTypeId, case WHEN c.msg_notify_company='2' then IFNULL(c.msg_notify_limit,24)*60 else IFNULL(c.msg_notify_limit,30) end msg_notify_limit ,IFNULL(c.msg_notify_company,1) as msg_notify_company, c.msg_send_time_interval, a.industry_code, a.app_ver_code, c.notify_admin_flag as 'notifyManager', c.user_type, c.data_filter_permiss AS 'dataFilterPermiss', c.time_limit_push AS 'timeLimePush', (select GROUP_CONCAT(d.user_id) from vm_flow_link_user d where d.attr_id=c.id and d.grid_sign ='0') AS 'userIds', (select GROUP_CONCAT(d.user_id) from vm_flow_link_user d where d.attr_id=c.id and d.grid_sign ='1') AS 'gridUserIds', (select group_concat(DISTINCT(role_id)) from vm_flow_link_role as flr WHERE flr.link_id = c.link_id and flr.attr_id = c.id and flr.grid_sign ='0') AS 'roleIds', (select group_concat(DISTINCT(role_id)) from vm_flow_link_role as flr WHERE flr.link_id = c.link_id and flr.attr_id = c.id and flr.grid_sign ='1') AS 'gridRoleIds' from vm_flow_template_alarm_type a LEFT JOIN vm_alarm_flow_config b on b.id=a.alarm_flow_id LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_attr c on b.id=c.alarm_flow_id where c.msg_notify_type like CONCAT('%','2','%') and c.real_link_type='1' and c.delete_flag='0' and a.delete_flag='0' and a.warning_source NOT IN ('2', '3') and c.time_push_type='1' GROUP BY a.tenant_id,a.alarm_type,c.link_id

select DISTINCT b.link_id linkId,a.industry_code, a.app_ver_code, a.warning_source, b.data_filter_permiss AS 'dataFilterPermiss', case WHEN b.msg_notify_company='2' then IFNULL(b.msg_notify_limit,24)*60 else IFNULL(b.msg_notify_limit,30) end msg_notify_limit ,IFNULL(b.msg_notify_company,1) as msg_notify_company, b.notify_admin_flag as 'notifyManager', '2' as user_type, b.role_id as role_users, b.role_id as 'roleIds', b.time_limit_push AS 'timeLimePush', b.grid_sign_role as 'gridRoleIds' from vm_flow_template_industry a LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_industry_config b on b.industry_code=a.industry_code and a.app_ver_code=b.app_ver_code where a.delete_flag='0' and a.`status`='1' and b.msg_notify_type like CONCAT('%','2','%') and b.delete_flag='0' and b.link_id='1' and time_push_type ='1'

SELECT DISTINCT link_id AS 'linkId', tenant_id, warning_type_id AS 'alarmTypeId', industry_code, app_ver_code, grid_id AS 'gridId' FROM ${tableName} WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND order_status = '1'
AND DATE_FORMAT( alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= DATE_FORMAT( now(), '%Y-%m-%d' )
GROUP BY tenant_id, warning_type_id, industry_code, app_ver_code, link_id, grid_id

SELECT link_id linkId,tenant_id, warning_type_id AS alarmTypeId, device_code,'' as region_code, warning_source, industry_code, app_ver_code, count(1) AS judgeNum,grid_id gridId, if(DATE_FORMAT( alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d') =DATE_FORMAT( now(), '%Y-%m-%d' ),'1','0') flag FROM ${tableName} WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND order_status = '1' and find_in_set(warning_source,'1,2,3,4,8,10')
AND DATE_FORMAT( alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= DATE_FORMAT( now(), '%Y-%m-%d' )
AND(
(tenant_id = #{item.tenantId} AND warning_type_id = #{item.alarmTypeId})
)
GROUP BY tenant_id, warning_type_id, warning_source, industry_code, app_ver_code, device_code,link_id,gridId,flag union all SELECT link_id AS 'linkId',tenant_id, warning_type_id AS 'alarmTypeId', '' as device_code,county_code as region_code, warning_source, industry_code, app_ver_code, count(1) AS 'judgeNum',grid_id AS 'gridId', if(DATE_FORMAT( alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d') =DATE_FORMAT( now(), '%Y-%m-%d' ),'1','0') flag FROM ${tableName} WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND order_status = '1' and warning_source ='9'
AND DATE_FORMAT( alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= DATE_FORMAT( now(), '%Y-%m-%d' )
AND(
(tenant_id = #{item.tenantId} AND warning_type_id = #{item.alarmTypeId})
)
GROUP BY tenant_id, warning_type_id, warning_source, industry_code, app_ver_code, county_code,link_id,gridId,flag

SELECT t1.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT t2.device_code ) as 'deviceCodeStr' FROM sys_user t1 LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t t2 ON t1.tenant_id = t2.tenant_id WHERE t2.delete_flag = '0'
AND(
(t1.user_id = #{item.userId} AND t2.dept_id LIKE concat(#{item.parentOrgId}, '%' ))
)
GROUP BY t1.user_id
select DISTINCT type_name as alarmTypeName ,type_value as alarmTypeId from sys_alarm_type where delete_flag = '0'

select u.user_id,u.dept_id,u.tenant_id,dr.industry_code ,dr.app_ver_code , dr.data_scope ,case when dr.data_scope ='2' then GROUP_CONCAT(rd.dept_id) else null end as custom_depts from sys_user u left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_role_data_rel dr on dr.role_id=r.role_id left join sys_role_dept rd on rd.role_id = r.role_id where u.del_flag='0' and dr.data_scope is not null
AND(
(u.user_id = #{item.userId} and dr.industry_code=#{item.industryCode} and dr.app_ver_code=#{item.appVerCode} )
)
group by u.user_id,dr.data_scope
select status as 'switchFlag' from sys_dict_type where status = '0' and dict_type = 'judge_send_msg_switch' limit 1

SELECT warning_order_id AS 'warningOrderId', device_code AS 'deviceCode', device_name AS 'device_name', warning_source AS 'warningSource' FROM ${tableName} WHERE warning_source in ('1','3','4') and warning_order_id IN
#{item}

update.foreach: update vm_sms_send_statistics_t set send_count =#{sms.sendCount} where send_date = #{sms.sendDate} and user_id=#{sms.userId}

mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${tableNewName} LIKE ${tableOldName}
